seoTitle: Porta Cabin & Portable Cabin Manufacturer in India | SAMAN
metaDescription: SAMAN manufactures porta cabins (portable cabins) in India. Six published sizes from ₹1,43,750 ex-GST, exact MS steel specs, delivery in 7–21 working days.
opener:
SAMAN manufactures porta cabins — the same product many buyers call portable cabins — at its own factories in Bengaluru and Greater Noida, and delivers across India. You get a factory-built steel cabin for a site office, guard room, retail counter or project room, without months of civil work.

Every cabin uses a welded MS chassis, a corrugated MS enclosure, insulated lining and protected copper electricals. The full specification is published, and you can download it below. Six workbook-controlled sizes run from 10x10 ft at ₹1,43,750 to 40x10 ft at ₹4,75,000 ex-GST. Your fixed-price quotation arrives within 48 hours. Standard delivery takes 7–21 working days.

descriptionHtml:
Porta Cabin and Portable Cabin: One Product, Two Names

Porta cabin and portable cabin are two names for the same factory-built steel cabin. Construction buyers, contractors and government tenders in India mostly write porta cabin. Corporate and residential buyers often search portable cabin instead. The product underneath does not change. It is a welded mild-steel chassis with an insulated enclosure, a finished interior and protected electricals. We build it in a factory and deliver it to your site as one module. SAMAN therefore publishes one specification, one price ladder and one quotation process for both names, on this single page.

This matters for more than vocabulary. Some suppliers keep separate porta cabin and portable cabin pages with different claims. Buyers then compare two versions of the same product with mismatched numbers. Our approach is the opposite. Every figure on this page traces to one controlled costing and specification workbook. The downloadable PDF in the hero carries the same numbers, the version marker and the source workbook they came from.

How SAMAN Builds Every Porta Cabin

Every cabin starts as a welded chassis of 100x50x3 mm MS C-channel with cross stiffeners. The floor is what a cabin lives or dies by, so the chassis gets the heaviest steel. Onto that frame we fix an 18 mm Bison cement-fibre floor board. A 1.3 mm vinyl layer finishes the walking surface. The wall frame uses 50x50 mm MS square pipe with an approximately 60 mm cavity. Outside, the walls carry 1.2 mm specially corrugated MS sheet. Inside, they carry 8 mm pre-laminated MDF lining. The roof runs 1.4 mm corrugated MS sheet over its own stiffener grid.

Insulation is standard, not an upsell. Walls take 25 mm glass wool or 12 mm Heatlon. The roof takes 50 mm glass wool at 42 kg/m³ nominal density, because that is where Indian sun load actually hits. The 7x3 ft MS-framed main door opens outward. Two-track powder-coated aluminium sliding windows carry 4 mm glass. Electricals run in concealed or protected copper wiring on a 1.5/2.5/4 sq.mm schedule. A distribution board with MCB/RCCB protection and earthing controls the circuits. Ventilation is natural cross-flow, with fan, exhaust and AC provisions as scheduled. Plumbing is not included unless your approved scope states it.

Two build facts deserve honest emphasis. First, engineered lifting points are part of the structure. The cabin is designed to be moved, and that is what makes it genuinely portable rather than merely prefabricated. Second, the final colour, openings and fit-out follow your approved drawing. The images on this page are approved SAMAN visualisations of the standard build, not a fixed appearance. The complete line-by-line specification sits in the Specifications tab and in the versioned PDF.

Read the Approved GA Plan Before You Fix a Size

Each of the six sizes on this page now carries its approved general-arrangement plan. The plan shows the exact door and window positions, the workstation grid, the clear central aisle and the four exterior elevations for that footprint. Counts are stated on the plan itself: the 10x10 ft carries one door and three windows for four workstations, while the 40x10 ft carries three doors, a partition and twelve workstations with a separate manager cabin.

Use the plan to test your layout before you commit. Check that the door falls on the side your site access allows, that the window line suits your orientation, and that the seat count matches your team. These are buyer-facing arrangements: fabrication, services and foundations still follow the approved project drawing issued with your order.

Choose Your Configuration: The Full SAMAN Porta Cabin Range

This page covers the standard porta cabin and its six sizes. Ten specialised configurations sit under it. Each one keeps the same chassis platform and changes one thing deliberately. The table below gives a buyer choosing between eleven builds the side-by-side routing view that prose cannot give. Every configuration is one click away.

ConfigurationBuilt for

Is your requirement a cabin to live in rather than work from? Then the porta cabin house page covers residential layouts. It is the right destination for home-use enquiries.

Porta Cabin Price in India: The Published Ladder

Most manufacturers in this market publish no prices at all. You receive a number only after a sales call. SAMAN publishes the ladder instead. A buyer who can see the price logic negotiates faster and trusts the quotation more. The table below lets you compare all six sizes at once — the single most requested comparison on this page.

These are base-specification supply prices. Customisations are quoted separately. The rate logic is simple and published. The 20x10 ft cabin at ₹1,250 per sq ft is the anchor. Smaller cabins carry a premium band, because the chassis, door and electricals cost the same regardless of size. Larger cabins earn a discount band.

Four factors move a final quote away from the ladder. Interior fit-out adds partitions, furniture and AC. Optional additions include an attached toilet module. Transport cost follows distance, per the Shipping tab. Finally, site conditions at unloading can change the last leg. GST applies at 18% under HSN 9406 for prefabricated buildings.

Porta Cabin or Container Office: Which One Do You Need?

Buyers often shortlist a porta cabin against a container office. The two are different structures, however, and the difference decides the price and the feel. A porta cabin is purpose-built on an MS C-channel chassis with a ~60 mm insulated wall cavity. It is lighter, arrives in more size options, and starts at a lower price point. A container office, in contrast, starts from a much heavier corten-steel shipping-container shell. That shell suits brutal handling, stacking and long outdoor service, and it carries a higher starting price.

Choose the porta cabin when you need an economical, well-insulated room fast, in a size matched to your plot. Consider a container office instead when the structure will be lifted repeatedly, stacked, or left in aggressive outdoor conditions for years. SAMAN manufactures both families in the same factories. If your enquiry fits the container side better, tell us the duty in your message. We will quote the right platform rather than force this one.

What Buyers Use Porta Cabins For

Site and project offices are the largest use. A contractor orders the cabin with the work order, and the office lands before the first excavation. General-purpose rooms come next: security points, drivers' rooms, first-aid rooms, storage and sample rooms. Retail and service use covers shops, kiosks, ticket counters and reception units, usually in the shop configuration. Sanitation and project-support configurations round out the family, from toilet-fitted cabins to stores.

The common thread is time. Civil construction of a 200 sq ft room takes months and leaves debris. A porta cabin arrives finished, works the same day it is placed, and moves to the next site when the project ends. That reuse is also why buyers who once rented often switch to owning.

Porta Cabin on Terrace and Rooftop

Rooftop placement is one of the most asked questions on this page. It often works, because the module weighs far less than an equivalent masonry room. Two checks decide feasibility. First, your structural engineer must confirm the slab can carry the cabin at the planned position. Second, there must be crane or lifting access to the roof level.

Share the building height, slab details and access photos with your enquiry. We then advise on the lift plan and quote accordingly. However, never place a cabin on a roof without the engineer's confirmation. That check is the buyer's responsibility, and we state it plainly.

Customisation Options

The published price buys the standard open-room specification. Almost everything else is configurable. STANDARD scope covers the shell, insulation, floor, one door, windows and the electrical baseline. OPTIONAL additions include partitions, furniture packages, AC provision and units, attached toilet modules, extra doors and windows, and grills or mesh.

CUSTOM work covers layouts, colours and openings, which follow your approved drawing. EXCLUDED items are plumbing (unless the approved scope states it), foundations, transport and installation, which are quoted separately. Every option is priced as a line item on the quote. So you can add or remove scope and see the effect immediately.

Delivery, Installation and Site Readiness

Standard delivery takes 7–21 working days from confirmed order. Your fixed-price quotation arrives within 48 hours of sharing requirements. Cabins dispatch from the nearer factory: Bengaluru for the South, Greater Noida for the North. Transport runs on 20 ft or 40 ft open trailers, priced by the distance ladder in the Shipping tab. Delivery within Bangalore city and Delhi NCR (Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Faridabad, Noida, Greater Noida) is free.

Prepare these before the trailer arrives, and installation day stays short:

  • A level, load-bearing base — compacted ground, plinth or columns per your approved drawing
  • Clear vehicle approach and turning room for a 20 ft or 40 ft trailer
  • Unloading arrangement as confirmed in your delivery quotation
  • A power supply point for hook-up to the cabin's distribution board
  • The person authorised to sign delivery and placement acceptance

How to Compare Porta Cabin Quotations

Cheap quotes usually hide in the specification, not the price. Compare line items, and the differences surface fast. Ask every vendor for the same five numbers:

  • Chassis section and thickness (ours: 100x50x3 mm MS C-channel)
  • Wall and roof sheet thickness (ours: 1.2 mm and 1.4 mm corrugated MS)
  • Insulation type and thickness in walls and roof
  • Electrical protection (DB with MCB/RCCB and earthing, or a bare board)
  • What the price excludes — transport, installation, foundations, plumbing

A quotation that cannot state these numbers is not comparable. Ours are printed in the Specifications tab and in the versioned PDF, so you can check delivery against the promise, line by line.

Quality Checks, Warranty and Honest Scope

Every cabin passes pre-dispatch QA before it leaves the factory. The checks cover dimensions, member and panel condition, enclosure sealing, and service function tests. You get a 5-year structural warranty and a 1-year finishing warranty as standard. The finishing warranty is extendable to 2 years on request. Under proper use and maintenance, the service life is 20–25 years. That is a design-life statement, not a warranty period, and the distinction matters when you compare vendors.

Scope honesty, in one place: the published price includes the structural shell, enclosure, insulation, floor, standard door and windows, and the electrical baseline. It excludes interior fit-out, optional add-ons, transport, installation, foundations and project-specific engineering, unless your quotation states them. Plumbing appears only when your approved scope includes it. Standard returns cover a 7-day non-defective window for new and unused stock items. Custom and site-specific builds are not returnable, and defects must be reported within 3 days.

Why Buy From SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Private Limited — brand SAMAN Portable — was founded in 2009 and incorporated in 2019. That is over 15 years of manufacturing experience. Two owned factory units, in Bengaluru and Greater Noida, mean you buy from the manufacturer, not a reseller, in both halves of the country. The delivery record stands at 500+ projects for 3,000+ customers across 15+ states, executed by a 200+ member team. Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018, with NSIC SPRS registration. Working hours are Monday to Saturday, 09:00–20:00 IST.

Porta Cabin FAQs

What does a porta cabin cost per square foot?

The published band runs from ₹1,187.50 to ₹1,437.50 per sq ft ex-GST, depending on size. The anchor is ₹1,250 for the 20x10 ft reference cabin. Smaller cabins sit higher because fixed components dominate their cost.

What sizes does a porta cabin come in?

Six published sizes: 10x10, 20x8, 20x10, 20x12, 30x10 and 40x10 ft, all 8.5 ft high. Custom dimensions are possible against an approved drawing and quotation.

Can a porta cabin be installed on a terrace or rooftop?

Often yes, because the module is far lighter than masonry. Your structural engineer must confirm the slab first, and lifting access decides feasibility. See the terrace section above.

Do I need a foundation?

You need a level, load-bearing base: compacted ground, a plinth or columns per the approved drawing. Full civil foundations are usually unnecessary, and any base work is outside the published price.

How long does delivery take?

7–21 working days as standard after order confirmation, plus transit per the Shipping tab ladder. Your quotation states the committed schedule.

Is GST included in the published prices?

Prices are shown ex-GST with the 18% inclusive figure alongside, under HSN 9406 for prefabricated buildings.

How long does a porta cabin last?

20–25 years under proper use and maintenance. The warranty itself is 5 years structural and 1 year finishing, extendable to 2.

Should I rent or buy?

Buy when the requirement crosses roughly a year, or when the cabin must be customised. Rent for short projects. Ask our team about monthly rental options when you send your enquiry.

Can I customise the layout?

Yes. Partitions, furniture packages, AC provision, attached toilet modules, colours and openings all follow your approved drawing. Each appears as a separate line on the quote, above the base price.
